issue.description: Console warning "Page was created with unknown prop 'params'" appearing during navigation between pages
issue.impact: Produces console warnings but doesn't break functionality

root_cause.primary: SvelteKit 2 migration issue - page components receiving 'params' prop they don't declare
root_cause.details: - In SvelteKit 2, route parameters are accessed via load functions, not component props - Page components shouldn't declare 'export let params' - The warning occurs when SvelteKit internally passes params to components that don't expect them

symptoms.symptom: Stack trace references internal Svelte/SvelteKit files

additional_observations.observation: Two duplicate npm run dev processes detected in background
This may cause additional issues or conflicts

solution_approach.step: Search for all +page.svelte files with 'export let params' declarations
Remove direct params props from page components
Ensure params are accessed through load functions
Test navigation between pages to confirm fix

pattern_change.new: Access params through $page store or load function
